The world has undergone a "great storage squeeze" over the last year, as memory shortages have driven up storage prices across all markets. The pinch is felt most strongly in #AIinfrastructure buildouts, which demand massive capacity from #datastorage systems to supply frontier models and #AIagents with relevant data, as well as high-performance delivery of that data. 

An experienced enterprise storage executive reflects on how #AI could be both the cause of storage management woes and their potential remedy.

Featuring: Adrian Johnson, CRO, Hitachi Vantara

In today's episode, we'll cover…


 🏗️ 	The multi-faceted AI infrastructure problems CIOs face

 🗺️ 	Data sovereignty concerns' effect on storage management

 🤖 	How Hitachi Vantara is using agentic AI for storage supply chain management


And more!

Tune in here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CySxuLTuPdU
